description: A small PadSynth voice with no faders of its own: the partials are set by cable, which is what the Faders module is for

params.text: Sets how wide each partial is spread in the spectrum, 0.5 to 60; wider partials give the chorused, breathing quality of a pad
Sets how much that width grows towards the higher partials, 0.5 to 4
Sets the seed the phases of the partials are drawn from, 0 to 1, which changes the sound a little without changing the harmonics
Sets the fundamental frequency the wavetable is built at, 16Hz to 2048Hz as a power of two; raising it helps when only high notes are played

inputs.text: The pitch the wavetable is read at, 1V per octave, one channel per voice
Sets the bandwidth by cable, 0-10V across the whole of the knob's span, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets that growth by cable, 0-10V across the whole of the knob's span, and moves the knob while it is patched
Sets the strengths of the first sixteen partials, one channel per partial, 0-10V for each; the panel lettering 1-16 is right and the maker's tooltip, Partials 2-17, is off by one
Sets the strengths of the seventeenth to the thirty-second partials, one channel per partial, 0-10V for each
Sets the strengths of the thirty-third to the forty-eighth partials, one channel per partial, 0-10V for each

outputs.text: The left side of the wave
The right side of the wave, which is the same table read half a cycle away, so the two sides differ

notes: no partial is set when the module is placed, so it makes no sound until something is patched into the partial jacks; with the first of the three empty the other two are passed over as well
every change to the partials builds the wavetable again in a background thread, which the patch carries on playing through
place Faders to the left of PAD2 and press f over it to fetch that module's partials, then patch the Faders outputs here to carry the sound across

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the BW knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Scl knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads silence; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads silence; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads silence; a negative voltage does nothing here.
